name: Tie-breaker maintenance isolation interface
aliases: switchgear Switchboard source and bus interfaces
summary: Identifies the isolation connections associated with the bus-tie breaker.
description: Identifies the isolation connections associated with the bus-tie breaker. A source and bus arrangement shows how incoming supplies and outgoing circuits can be connected. Breaker and tie positions determine which sections are energized and whether sources can become electrically paralleled.

In a switchgear lineup with two incomers and a bus tie, the single-line arrangement helps the engineer identify normal supply paths and which loads change source during a transfer. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Tie breaker and isolating points” at the input and “Maintainable tie interface” at the output. The drawing is not a switching instruction.

Keep normal positions, transfer limits, source independence and protection-zone boundaries visible.
